metadata.goldEngravingNote: Premium/prestige case models reserved for Gold members with 'Gold engraving' designation: Aramid Dual Ultra (24K Gold Dipped), Urban Nav, and the Scepter/Fortune series. These are the flagship aramid fiber cases with 24K gold dipped accents and the premium leather Nav variants.

goldEngravingCriteria: Gold engraving is reserved for premium/prestige case models: the Aramid Dual Ultra (24K Gold Dipped Fortune Dual series) and Urban Nav (premium leather Nav series). These represent the flagship offerings in their respective material categories — luxury aramid fiber with 24K gold accents and premium genuine leather with sophisticated Nav styling.
